entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: The Tide Star, great ryuu (divine dragon) of Kamigawa's islands who guarded Minamo and the Kamitaki Falls; later reincarnated as Kairi.

entities.name: Kairi
entities.description: The Swirling Sky, Keiga's reborn form, jailer of Hidetsugu in the spirit realm.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki
entities.description: Akki entrusted by Keiga with recovering a stolen egg.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: O-bakemono who killed Keiga and was later jailed by Kairi.

entities.name: Minamo School
entities.description: School Keiga was defending when killed.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Place beneath which Keiga slept in an egg.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Keiga was killed.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Kairi briefly freed Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: Said in one source to be Keiga's brother.

events.summary: Before the Kami War Keiga meets Kiki-Jiki, entrusts him with recovering an egg stolen by Meloku, and helps him unlock his magic.
events.quote: entrusted him with the mission of recovering an egg that was stolen by Meloku

events.summary: During the Kami War Hidetsugu kills Keiga while he defends the Minamo School.
events.quote: Keiga was killed by the o-bakemono Hidetsugu

events.summary: After a fifty-year slumber in an egg beneath Boseiju, Keiga is reborn as Kairi.
Kairi, jailer of Hidetsugu, briefly frees the oni to help defend Kamigawa from the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The spirit dragon briefly freed the oni to participate in the defense of Kamigawa

relations.note: Killed him in the Kami War.
relations.quote: Keiga was killed by the o-bakemono Hidetsugu

relations.note: Serves as his jailer in the spirit realm.
relations.quote: Kairi serves as Hidetsugu's jailer in the spirit realm

relations.note: Entrusted him with a mission and helped him.
relations.quote: the dragon helped the akki to unlock his inner magic talents
